title: The Sperner-system strengthening of Snevily's conjecture
statement:
Let $n,s$ be integers with $n\geq 2s-1$, let $L=\{\ell_{1},\ell_{2},\ldots,\ell_{s}\}$ be a set of $s$ non-negative integers, and let an **$L$-intersecting Sperner system** be a Sperner family $\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ such that $|F\cap F'|\in L$ for every distinct $F,F'\in\mathcal{F}$. **The Sperner-system strengthening.** Every such family satisfies

$$
|\mathcal{F}|\leq\binom{n}{s}.
$$

The source presents this as a stronger conjecture than Snevily's conjecture. The bound is immediate from the LYM inequality when $n<2s-1$, while the stated range is not settled in the supplied text.
source_name: Jun Gao, Hong Liu and Zixiang Xu, “Stability through non-shadows”, arXiv:2212.07821 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.07821

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2022).
